name: Gloom Stalker
description: A ranger who specializes in ambushing enemies from darkness, striking first and fastest.

bonus_spells_by_level._notes: Real PHB/XGE Gloom Stalker Magic tiers — verified 2026-09-16/17 against the feature's own stored description text (pub_gloom-stalker-magic) and confirmed as the real 2014 XGE version, not a 2024/UA substitution. Found and wired 2026-09-17: this table was previously undocumented data-side and unwired code-side (see TODO.md's 'Gloom Stalker Ranger's tiered bonus spells' entry) — src/utils/spellUtils.js's BONUS_SPELL_FIELDS now reads this field the same way it already reads oath_spells_by_level/domain_spells_by_level/psionic_spells_by_level, so these 5 spells now surface correctly in the spellbook and in LevelUpTool's 'you just gained these' breakpoint display, keyed off the character's own Ranger level (not total character level — this is bound to one class/subclass, unlike species-granted tiered spells).
